facts.fact: 回到家Lucia抓起grimoire跪在地板中央，鼻尖抵着封面哀求它告诉她该怎么办。
facts.quote: “Tell me!” I screamed, my nose touching the cover as I prostrated myself.

facts.fact: 她呼念「Florescentia」召唤失败——grimoire自动弹开、页页全黑——她把书页一张张撕下，书却永远不变薄。
facts.quote: One by one, I ripped them from the bindings, yet the book never got thinner.

facts.fact: 她取来Everie牌占问：牌组含主星座四张（four major constellations）、小星十八张（eighteen minor stars），其余五十六张（fifty-six）按四季划分、各分正位Nova与逆位Eclipse；抽到的第一张是正位「The Gambler」。
facts.quote: The Everie contained the four major constellations and eighteen minor stars.

facts.fact: 电话里传来丈夫Dorian的声音，机械重复她的话；她不敢相信是本人，挂断了电话。
再接起的电话是coroner's office来电谈遗体交付瞻仰；她报住址626 on Sixth Avenue，请对方联系Maxim Collesano安排交付日期。
她查明上一次仪式是被自己的影伴Peculiars（Absinthe与Tonic）中断的——正是它们关掉了仪式。
facts.quote: Suddenly, it became clear who—or rather, what—had interrupted my last ritual.

facts.fact: 二次召唤中巨兽从虚空爬出；它拔下Lucia发间的鸢尾令其枯萎，还用她自己的声音学舌「Beast」。
facts.quote: “Beast,” it mocked in my ear, with my own voice.

facts.fact: 巨兽躯干纵裂露出牙齿与嘴、要将她吞吃；她放声尖叫，再睁眼时巨兽、Peculiars与鸢尾已尽数消失，天已亮。
facts.quote: These were teeth. That was a mouth. And it was going to eat me.
